ov: Two species of antelope from eastern and southern Africa, also called gnus: the blue wildebeest and the black wildebeest. The blue is the most abundant big-game species in East Africa and a famous sight in the Serengeti and the Maasai Mara. Calves can soon keep up with the herd.

why.et: Traditionally hunted for hides and meat, though the meat is coarse and tough.

fx: Some populations migrate each year to follow the rains and fresh grass; the black wildebeest is only nomadic.
Hunting pushed the black wildebeest out of its old range; it now lives mostly on game farms and in reserves.
